book.source_scope: The exact attached original PDF and exact supplied data files. External primary sources are used only for compilation/translation identity and Sunni provenance, never to fill source text.
book.text_method: Fresh original-PDF rendering at400dpi with PyMuPDF1.26.6 and direct independent visual comparison of every assigned page and supplied component; evidence recorded in current page/record ledgers. Prior completion claims are archived, not inherited.

transcription_policy.language: Preserve Arabic, Filipino/Tagalog and Roman transliteration as printed; do not translate or rewrite.
transcription_policy.typesetting: Line breaks and text components are encoded in Unicode. Calligraphic honorifics may be represented with Unicode honorific symbols or transcribed Arabic honorific wording where the reviewer read the glyph; this is not graphic facsimile fidelity. The actual glyph shape remains in the source image and related uncertainty flags.
transcription_policy.uncertainty: Uncertain diacritics, glyphs, readings, structure and missing data must remain explicitly flagged. An image-compared record is not automatically certified character-perfect.
transcription_policy.numbers: Hisnul Muslim item numbers, chapter numbers, footnote markers, original-source hadith numbers and volume/page locators are distinct fields.
transcription_policy.apparent_source_errors: Preserve printed conflicts and apparent errors; report them without silently correcting the source.
transcription_policy.references: References are transcribed claims in this PDF, not independently authenticated or upgraded citations.
transcription_policy.excerpt_status: The preface describes this book as presenting dhikr excerpts rather than every full original hadith. Only the text actually printed here is extracted.

review_limitations: Arabic mark/glyph fidelity has unresolved source-specific cases.
Some ancillary cover text cannot be read confidently.
Final corrected bytes and new structured annotations require a further final independent Pro evaluation.

sunni_provenance.scope: Identity and Sunni provenance of the compilation and this Filipino translation. This assessment does not authenticate each narration, validate every printed citation, or establish every grading claim.
sunni_provenance.nature_of_conclusion: Evidence-based editorial inference from the matching author/work/translation identity, issuing institution, author's documented scholarly lineage, and the original compilation's institutional circulation. No literal sect label was added to source text.

source_pdf_evidence.supports: Printed title, author Sa'eed ibn Ali ibn Wahf Al-Qahtani, translator Abdulkhaliq Sharif Saripada, corrector Daud M. Angni, Wikang Tagalog label.
Arabic original-work title/author and catalog publisher; catalog describes 280 pages and gives 1425 AH.
Printed issuing office in Sulay and third-edition statement, confirmed in the fresh page276 review and ancillary transcription.
